dimensionScores.evidence: sandbox-ports.ts closeSandboxTab() (lines 90-105) is no-op-safe: an absent stored id returns {closed:false,hadTab:false} via the early return at 92-94; a chrome.tabs.remove rejection is caught (95-102), the id cleared, and {closed:false,hadTab:false} returned, so a twice-in-a-row or manually-closed tab never throws or rejects. The 10-vs-9 differentiator is that page-actions.ts ALSO wraps the handler in guard() (line 1378), so an unexpected throw from readStoredTabId/storage (outside the port's own try/catch) surfaces as {error} rather than an unhandled rejection.

page-actions.ts closeSandboxTab (1262-1269) calls only sandboxTab.closeSandboxTab(); sandbox-ports.ts removes exactly the single id read via readStoredTabId (chrome.tabs.remove(storedId) at line 96) with no chrome.tabs.query/enumeration and no other tab id ever reachable. The 9-vs-10 gap: non-interference is proven by handler-level assertNoTabTraffic (page-actions.unit.test.ts 2768-2779, 10 ports asserted uncalled) and single-id strict matchers (toHaveBeenCalledWith(7)) rather than an explicit multi-tab fixture asserting remove is never passed a non-sandbox id.

capture-ports.ts is unmodified (git diff is empty and it is absent from the modified-files list); neither page-actions.ts closeSandboxTab nor sandbox-ports.ts closeSandboxTab references captureStore/evict or imports capture-buffer — no capture-buffer-clearing or duplicated eviction logic exists in the close path. The 10-vs-9 differentiator: the close path verifiably carries zero capture references (only the generic onTabRemoved listener owns eviction, as the sandbox-ports doc comment at lines 51-52 explicitly states), so no reviewer could ask for more.

The 9-vs-10 gap: there is no dedicated catalog test asserting closeSandboxTab's empty-properties no-args schema (the ping/getTabState/navigateBack no-args schema tests omit it; only the generic PAGE_ACTIONS loop covers its description/schema).

Three behavior tests in sandbox-ports.unit.test.ts — close-and-clear (176-189, asserts result {closed:true,hadTab:true}, remove called with 7, storage cleared), no-op (191-202, result {closed:false,hadTab:false}, remove NOT called), stale/already-closed (204-217, remove rejects → caught, cleared, no-op result) — plus two handler tests in page-actions.unit.test.ts (2766-2810) asserting the delegated result shape and no-tab traffic.
